framework.name: PCI DSS 4.0
framework.description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0 — 12 requirements for protecting cardholder data.

controls.title: Network security controls established
controls.description: Processes and mechanisms for installing and maintaining network security controls are defined and understood.

controls.title: Network access restricted
controls.description: Network security controls are configured and maintained to restrict inbound and outbound traffic.

controls.title: Network access to/from cardholder data restricted
controls.description: Network access to and from the cardholder data environment is restricted.

controls.title: System components configured securely
controls.description: System components are configured and managed securely.

controls.title: Storage of account data is kept to a minimum
controls.description: Account data is minimized and retention kept to minimum required.

controls.title: Primary account number secured
controls.description: PAN is secured with strong cryptography.

controls.title: PAN protected during transmission
controls.description: PAN is protected with strong cryptography during transmission over open public networks.

controls.title: Anti-malware mechanisms deployed
controls.description: Anti-malware mechanisms are deployed on all system components.

controls.title: Bespoke and custom software developed securely
controls.description: Bespoke and custom software are developed securely.

controls.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and addressed
controls.description: Security vulnerabilities are identified and protected against.

controls.title: Access to system components and data is restricted
controls.description: Access to system components and data is appropriately defined and assigned.

controls.title: User identification and authentication managed
controls.description: User identification and related accounts are managed throughout an account's lifecycle.

controls.title: User authentication
controls.description: User authentication is established and managed.

controls.title: MFA implemented
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is implemented for all access into the CDE.

controls.title: Media with cardholder data secured
controls.description: All media with cardholder data is secured.

controls.title: Audit logs implemented
controls.description: Audit logs are implemented to support the detection of anomalies and suspicious activity.

controls.title: Audit logs reviewed
controls.description: Audit logs are reviewed to identify anomalies or suspicious activity.

controls.title: Failures of security controls detected and reported
controls.description: Failures of critical security controls are detected, reported, and responded to promptly.

controls.title: External and internal vulnerabilities identified and addressed
controls.description: External and internal vulnerabilities are regularly identified, prioritized, and addressed.

controls.title: External and internal penetration testing
controls.description: External and internal penetration testing is regularly performed.

controls.title: Risks to cardholder data identified and managed
controls.description: Risks to the cardholder data environment are formally identified, evaluated, and managed.

controls.title: Suspected and confirmed security incidents responded to
controls.description: Suspected and confirmed security incidents that could impact the CDE are responded to immediately.
